exports.description: A label with one template per CLDR plural category of its locale, `other` required. A locale lists exactly the categories `Intl.PluralRules` has for it (en-US: `one`, `other`; pl: `one`, `few`, `many`, `other`). Exact-number keys (`'=0'`) are not supported.
exports.name: PluralLabel

exports.description: Fills a label. A `PluralLabel` picks its template by `values.count`, through `new Intl.PluralRules(locale).select(values.count)` (`other` when the category is missing or `count` is not a number); a plain string is used as is. Each `{name}` placeholder is replaced by `values.name`: a number formatted with `Intl.NumberFormat(locale)`, a string as written. A placeholder with no value stays as written: `formatLabel('+{count}', { count: 1200 })` is `'+1,200'`.
exports.name: formatLabel

parameters.description: BCP 47 tag for the plural rules and the numbers.
